cornerPost.frame: plan: u = along wall (s), v = depth from exterior plane (d)
cornerPost.note: u along the wall leaving the corner, v = that wall inward

insideCorner.frame: plan: u = along wall (s), v = depth from exterior plane (d)

maleLeft.frame: plan: u = along wall (s), v = depth from exterior plane (d)
maleLeft.note: left vertical of a panel; leg tip at u=0

femaleRight.frame: plan: u = along wall (s), v = depth from exterior plane (d)
femaleRight.note: right vertical of a panel; leg tip at u=0

wallChannelRight.frame: plan: u = s measured from the house line (house end on the RIGHT, u <= 0), v = depth

rail.frame: wall section: u = depth from exterior (d), v = height above the die origin (bottom of profile)

receiverBottom.frame: wall section: u = depth from exterior (d), v = height above the bottom seat line (leg tips at 0)

receiverTop.frame: wall section: u = depth from exterior (d), v = height relative to the top seat line (leg tips at 0, v <= 0)

channelBottom.frame: wall section: u = depth from exterior (d), v = height above the channel underside

channelTop.frame: wall section: u = depth from exterior (d), v = height relative to the channel top surface (v <= 0)

roofBackChannel.frame: roof section, house-anchored: u = Y - house Y, v = Z - house height

roofGutter.frame: roof section, low-edge-anchored: u = Y, v = Z - low wall height

roofFasciaLeft.frame: roof fascia: u = along eave from roof start X0 (outward = -u), v = along roof normal (Y,Z-84).n; section lies at slope coordinate tOffset
